theme_zh: 智能穿戴反事实与因果推理
interpretation: Project-specific top-level thematic navigation. Function/variable and intervention facets are distinct, may overlap, and do not rank evidence or relabel all wearable studies as causal.

layers.label: Reasoning questions
layers.description: Model explanations, causal estimands, longitudinal effects, recourse and policy evaluation; semantics are recorded separately.

layers.label: Functions and variables
layers.description: Identity, behavior, physiology, sleep, disease risk and other target functions; causal variable roles are contextual.

layers.label: Interventions and delivery
layers.description: Fixed support, contextual rules, learned policies and closed-loop systems; study design and outcomes remain independent facets.

functions.label: Identity / fingerprinting
functions.description: Who generated the sensor history? Identity discrimination and re-identification risk.

functions.label: Activity and behavior
functions.description: What behavior occurred and how much? Activity labels, walking and steps.

functions.label: Physiological and affective state
functions.description: Heart, glucose, stress and other state measures; not necessarily actionable.

functions.label: Sleep and circadian patterns
functions.description: Sleep states, duration and rhythm measurements.

functions.label: Disease and prognosis
functions.description: Detection, incident risk, prognosis and survival; keep cross-sectional diagnosis separate from future outcomes.

functions.label: Functional status
functions.description: Mobility, recovery, motor impairment and physical function.

functions.label: Context, availability and receptivity
functions.description: Can and should support be delivered at this time? Need and receptivity are not the same variable.

functions.label: Measurement quality
functions.description: Validity, artifacts, missingness, nonwear and device reliability.
